name: solitaire
title: Solitaire
description: Klondike in the panel, one-handed: the arrows walk the piles, Enter picks up and drops, Enter twice sends a card where it goes. Draw one or three, unlimited passes, undo; the game and the record persist.
author: pal

settings.label: Draw
settings.description: Cards turned from the stock at a time. Applies from the next deal.

store.tagline: Klondike on the arrows and Enter; the game and the record persist
features: The table as a view level: the title says what the cursor is on (`Pile 4 · 9♣ 8♥`), what you carry (`Moving 7♥ and 2 more`) or why a drop was refused (`7♥ can't go on 9♠`)
One-handed: `←` `→` walk the stock, the waste, the foundations and the seven piles, `↑` `↓` take more or fewer cards of a face-up run (and past it, the row above or below), `Enter` picks up and drops
`Enter` twice on the same card sends it where it goes: its foundation, else the first pile that takes it
Picked-up cards ride under the cursor and glide to where you drop them; a card turned over flips, the deal drops in column by column
Draw one or three (a setting), unlimited passes through the stock, `U` or `Backspace` undoes (a hundred moves back)
Once every card is face up the rest flies home by itself, one card at a time
Moves, the time played (only while the table is open) and games won of played beside the table; Escape leaves at any point and the game is there when you come back

screenshots.caption: A fresh deal: the cursor on the stock, the moves, the time and the record beside the table
Forty moves in: covered cards fan as strips of their own picture, eight cards home
Carrying a run: the picked-up cards ride under the cursor to the pile they go on
Won: every card home, Enter deals again

actions.title: Pick up, drop
actions.description: Enter on a card picks it up (with the cards under it, as deep as ↑ reached); Enter on another pile drops them there. On the stock, draws.

actions.title: Send where it goes
actions.description: Enter again on the pile the cards came from: to the card's foundation, else to the first pile that takes them.

actions.title: Previous pile, next pile
actions.description: Across the stock, the waste, the foundations and the seven piles, wrapping round. `h` and `l` too.

actions.title: More cards, fewer cards
actions.description: How deep into a face-up run to take; past it, the row above or below. `k` and `j` too.

actions.title: Draw
actions.description: From anywhere; turns the waste back over when the stock is out.

actions.title: Undo
actions.description: The last move back, or the cards you hold put back.

actions.title: New game
actions.description: Asks first mid-game; the game counts as lost.

solitaire.description: The table. Escape leaves mid-game; it is there when you come back.

keys.title: Pick up, drop; twice on the same card, send it where it goes; draw on the stock
One more card of the run, then the row above (also down, k, j)
New game, after a confirm mid-game
